text:
tara.sales: Meridian asked for a 2-week POC to evaluate switching from HelixAPI to Redwood. Primary asks: prompt parity (including function-calls), stateful session behavior, BYK/KMS rotation, and a token-billing delta estimate. Can we own tech + security?

ben.se: I can lead the presales side. Do they use streaming + tool-calls? That usually creates the biggest parity gaps.

tara.sales: Yes, streaming + function-calls + session affinity. They mentioned Helix uses per-call session tokens.

kevin.eng: I'll own parity experiments. Plan: run their sample prompts through our eval harness, add a tokenizer shim to normalize unicode/emoji and a "serialize-tools" compat toggle to preserve function-call ordering. Need their golden set (1k preferable).

ben.se: Also need sample Helix responses if they do post-processing. Token-count differences often come from tokenization and chunked streaming frames.

sasha.security: BYK note: Hosted cannot import customer keys into our HSM today. Dedicated/Private support BYK and KMS rotation. For the POC we can enable BYK on a small Dedicated pool but legal/ops addendum required.

maria.legal: I'll draft a short BYK addendum and an NDA amendment. Also check data residency: they want EU-only.

kevin.eng: We can spin a eu-west dedicated pool for the POC. Early estimate: token-delta ~+5-12% typical, but with streaming/tool framing variance could hit ~20% worst-case. We'll include example diffs.

tara.sales: Two-week deliverables: smoke tests, parity report with sample diffs, BYK path + lead time, and a billing delta projection. OK?

ben.se: OK. Action list: 1) eng: run parity harness + token deltas; 2) security: BYK checklist and ops ETA; 3) legal: addendum; 4) sales: collect acceptance criteria and discount request.

kevin.eng: Running initial pass today. Expect to push a short diff report in ~2 hours: 10 example diffs + token counts. I'll enable tokenizer shim and compatibility header X-compat-serialize-tools in the harness.

infra-bot: POC infra request received: 1x eu-west dedicated pool (2x A100), BYK enabled. ETA: 3 hours to provision minimal tenant.

ben.se: I'll email Meridian asking for the golden prompt set + volume metrics for billing projection. Present billing delta as absolute token delta plus projected monthly $ using their historic usage.

sasha.security: I'll follow up with ops on HSM import limitations and whether we can provide import for POC or need a temporary hosted KMS bridge.

maria.legal: Draft BYK addendum will be in your inbox EOD.

kevin.eng: Quick technical note: Helix trims trailing newlines and canonicalizes emoji which changed our token counts in initial samples. Shim fixes should narrow deltas. Also their function-call arg ordering is insertion-order; our runtime can reorder by libs. The serialize toggle preserves insertion order.

tara.sales: Great. I'll schedule kickoff for tomorrow morning. Acceptance criteria: parity >=90% on their golden set, BYK path confirmed, and initial billing delta. :thumbsup:
